hero.heading: Hi 👋 I'm Krishna and I like building my ideas.

journeyIntro.title: My Journey
journeyIntro.description: This is a glimpse into my path— from the early days of exploring ideas to the milestones that have shaped my creative and professional life. It’s a story of growth, challenges, and continuous learning

segments.text: I began my journey as a Computer Science Engineering student, which basically meant spending half my time solving bugs and the other half creating brand-new ones while trying to “optimize” perfectly working code. During my B.E. in Computer Science at
, I worked on multiple academic and team-based projects that taught me two important truths: Stack Overflow is a survival tool, and deadlines are more of a motivational concept than a strict rule.

body.text: Along the way, prerequisite subjects like data structures, databases, and data processing quietly set the stage for my growing interest in ETL methodologies—understanding how raw data moves, transforms, and finally becomes something meaningful instead of just sitting in tables judging you.

At the same time, I found myself drawn to UI and UX, realizing that even the smartest logic fails if users don’t enjoy clicking the button. This curiosity pushed me into hands-on work with HTML, CSS, and React, while the backend world pulled me toward SQL, Node.js, and Django, where I learned how systems actually think behind the scenes.

Somewhere between debugging layouts, wiring APIs, and cleaning messy data pipelines, I realized I didn’t want to wait around for opportunities—I wanted to build them. That mindset laid the groundwork for my journey into freelancing, where I started applying everything I’d learned to real-world problems, real users, and real deadlines

Worked as a Full-Stack Developer Intern with a strong focus on UI/UX and Frontend development, contributing to responsive, user-centric web applications while collaborating closely with backend and product teams.

body.title: # UI/UX Responsibilities
items: Translated business requirements and user flows into intuitive UI designs.
Designed wireframes, user journeys, and component layouts focused on usability and clarity.
Applied UX principles such as accessibility, visual hierarchy, consistency, and feedback.
Improved user experience by simplifying complex workflows into clean, easy-to-use interfaces.
Collaborated with stakeholders to iterate designs based on user feedback and testing insights.

body.title: # Development Flow & Methodologies
items: Followed component-driven development for scalable UI architecture.
Worked in an Agile environment, participating in sprint planning and reviews.
Used version control (Git) for collaboration and code quality.
Ensured performance optimization and clean UI rendering.

body.text: Marked a focused transition from internship-level responsibilities to professional full-stack development, taking ownership of production-grade applications and end-to-end system workflows.

items: Expanded from UI/UX and frontend implementation into full-stack ownership, contributing across frontend, backend, databases, and deployment.
Applied real-world engineering practices including scalable architecture design, API integration, authentication, and performance optimization.
Strengthened expertise in React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, SQL, and Django, working on domain-driven applications such as insurance, auditing, blogging, and project management systems.
Adopted production methodologies like modular architecture, reusable components, clean data modeling, and secure role-based access control.
Gained hands-on exposure to cloud deployment, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized workflows, aligning development with industry standards.
Transitioned mindset from learning-based execution to delivery-focused engineering, emphasizing reliability, maintainability, and user impact.
